purpose: Run 1 of the full offline gate for plan 07-17, preserved before a pre-declared second run replaces the working copies. Both runs stay on record.

failure.title: throw: cancels reload before award with 1ms remaining
firstErrorLines: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while running "beforeEach" hook.

firstThreeTests: throw: cancels reload before award with 1ms remaining (timedOut)
throw: cancels reload before award with 0ms remaining (passed)
throw: cancels reload before award with -1ms remaining (passed)
context: The machine had been restarted minutes before the run. The spec starts its own Vite server in beforeAll.

hypothesis.text: Cold start of the freshly created Vite server and cold file cache after the reboot, not a game or test-logic regression. Supported only by the timing pattern (30 s, 17.6 s, then about 4.5 s); no isolated rerun was made.

decision: The orchestrator decided, before seeing any second result: exactly one second offline run; both runs stay on record; a second failure of any case means stop and debug, no third run.
